परिचय

Hero Splendor Plus हमारी वैश्विक motorcycle specifications डायरेक्टरी में दर्ज है। देश/बाजार: India। यह जानकारी देने वाली गाइड है, नई लॉन्च या ताज़ा घटना की खबर नहीं।

स्रोत में दर्ज विवरण

  • Manufacturer: Hero MotoCorp
  • Model Version: Splendor+ standard family; excludes Splendor+ XTEC and XTEC2.0
  • Engine: 97.2cc, air-cooled 4-stroke single-cylinder OHC
  • Power: 5.9kW @8000 rpm
  • Torque: 8.05Nm @6000 rpm
  • Fuel System: Programmed Fuel Injection
  • Transmission: 4-speed constant mesh; wet multiplate clutch
  • Starting: Electric start
  • Mileage: 70 km/l manufacturer claim with E20 fuel; actual result varies
  • Weight: 112kg
  • Dimensions: 2000×720×1052mm
  • Seat Height: 785mm
  • Wheelbase: 1236mm
  • Ground Clearance: 165mm
  • Fuel Tank: 9.8 litres
  • Tyres: Front 80/100-18 47P, rear 80/100-18 54P; tubeless alloy wheels
  • Suspension: Telescopic hydraulic front; swingarm with five-step adjustable hydraulic rear
  • Brakes: Drum brakes; integrated braking system
  • Features: Analog meter; side-stand engine cut-off; i3S availability by variant
  • Warranty: 5 years/70,000km, whichever first; manufacturer terms apply
  • Price: ₹77,777–₹80,531 secondary-listed average ex-showroom range
  • Price Basis: BikeDekho, checked 2026-11-02; city/variant dependent, not an on-road quote
